caption: The drawing consists of two separate illustrations on a light beige background. On the left side, there is an image of a man and a woman standing together outdoors, depicted in a stylized manner. The man wears a black suit and a top hat, and holds a cane. The woman wears a bonnet and a voluminous orange skirt. Green trees with simple circular canopies and brown trunks are visible in the background, and the ground appears to be shaded in light green and brown tones. On the right side, there is a floral composition featuring a bouquet of stylized flowers. The flowers have petals in orange, yellow, and red hues with green stems and leaves; some small round elements in yellow and orange are scattered around the bouquet. Both illustrations are rendered on irregularly shaped pieces of beige paper, leaving broad margins of the plain background visible around them.
title: Wall Paper Sample
